run:
set -e
P=/tmp/orbit
rm -rf $P
mkdir -p $P/src/engine $P/src/net $P/tests $P/docs $P/target/debug
cd $P
printf '[package]
name = "orbit"
version = "0.4.2"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
serde = "1"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
' > Cargo.toml
printf '/target
*.log
' > .gitignore
printf '# orbit

A small job scheduler.
' > README.md
printf 'a
b
c
d
e
f
g
h
' > notes.txt
printf 'one
' > todo.txt
for m in main lib config; do printf '// %s
pub fn run() {}
' $m > src/$m.rs; done
for m in queue worker timer retry; do for i in 1 2 3; do printf '// engine %s %s
pub fn step() -> u32 { %s }
' $m $i $i > src/engine/${m}_$i.rs; done; done
for m in client server codec; do for i in 1 2; do printf '// net %s %s
pub fn open() {}
' $m $i > src/net/${m}_$i.rs; done; done
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do printf '#[test]
fn case_%s() { assert_eq!(1, 1); }
' $i > tests/case_$i.rs; done
for i in 1 2 3; do printf '# guide %s
' $i > docs/guide_$i.md; done
head -c 200000 /dev/urandom | base64 > target/debug/orbit.o
git init -q -b main .
git add -A
git -c user.name=dev -c user.email=dev@example.com commit -q -m "initial orbit scheduler"
git ls-files | wc -l
cd /root/orbit && cat $(git ls-files) > /dev/null; git status -s; git log --oneline | cat
cd /root/orbit && printf '// retry with backoff\n' >> src/engine/retry_1.rs; printf '# guide 4\n' > docs/guide_4.md
cd /tmp/orbit && printf '# orbit 0.5\n' > README.md; rm src/net/codec_2.rs
cd /root/orbit && mv docs/guide_3.md docs/setup.md; printf 'retries = 5\n' > settings.toml
cd /root/orbit && sh -c 'sed 1s/a/A/ notes.txt > .notes.tmp; sleep 4; mv .notes.tmp notes.txt'
cd /root/orbit && sh -c 'cp todo.txt .todo.tmp; printf "guest\n" > .todo.tmp; sleep 4; mv .todo.tmp todo.txt'
